decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the store is used.
Condition : 4 - The store hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 52 The Drive.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southwest and northeast walls of the store hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of outbuidling as store in rear garden of premises
